label: Who may be employed to do gas work in domestic premises
value: Anyone employed to work on gas appliances in domestic premises must be a Gas Safe registered engineer
quote: Anyone employed to work on gas appliances in domestic premises must be a Gas Safe registered engineer and competent in that area of gas work.
scope: Great Britain (the Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998, regulation 3; Northern Ireland has its own regulations). Stated in the lowriskquotes new-boiler cost guide.
